ApprovedOrigin.description:
One approved origin: a provider whose public description the index
collects.

catalogUrl.description:
Exact production HTTPS URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
Loopback HTTP is a development exception `discoveryctl` accepts only
with `--allow-loopback`, not part of this production authoring schema.

originId.description:
The origin's name in this project: 1 to 128 characters from `A-Z`,
`a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, and `-`.

OriginProfile.description: The publication profile an approved origin implements.

OriginsSchemaVersion.description: The header an origins file carries.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host and no user information.

description: The origins the operator approves for one index.
